display.purpose: Total portfolio value and other hero financial numbers.

body.purpose: Descriptions, APY metadata, and row notes.

elevation.name: flat-ledger-surface
elevation.purpose: Dashboard sections sit flat on the continuous dark surface.

motion.name: quiet-state-transition
motion.purpose: Navigation, row, and control state changes.

components.name: Mint Primary Button
components.description: Rare high-emphasis command in the mint accent.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: #9bd8c2; color: #0b1113; font: 700 14px/1.2 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #b7ead9; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f4f1ea; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ledger Section Row
components.description: Flat dashboard row with value, metadata, and divider.
components.css: .ds-ledger-row { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 16px 0; border-top: 1px solid #182225; color: #f4f1ea; background: transparent; font-family: 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-ledger-row h3 { margin: 0; color: #c4ccd3; font: 400 16px/1.3 Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif; } .ds-ledger-row p { margin: 8px 0 0; color: #8d98a3; font-size: 12px; } .ds-ledger-row strong { color: #f4f1ea; font: 700 14px/1.3 Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif; }

components.name: Progress Bar
components.description: Low, flat progress indicator for distribution rows.
components.css: .ds-progress { height: 4px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 4px; background: #151d20; } .ds-progress span { display: block; height: 100%; border-radius: inherit; background: #789f93; }

components.name: Maturity Pill
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 24px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: #151d20; color: #9bd8c2; font: 700 12px/1 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; }

components.name: Bottom Navigation Item
components.description: Icon-first mobile navigation with mint active state.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: inline-flex; height: 56px; min-width: 72px; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; color: #56616b; text-decoration: none; font: 500 11px/1.2 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; transition: color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: #8d98a3; } .ds-nav-item-active { color: #9bd8c2; }

narrative.overview: Trafin should feel like a dark, private ledger for fixed-income assets: quiet, exact, and easy to scan from a phone. The preferred visual baseline is assets/screenshots_2/dashboard_idea_1.png.
keyCharacteristics: Large serif portfolio value as the first read.
Compact sections separated by hairline dividers.
Mint accent used for positive value and active state only.
No floating card grid as the default dashboard structure.

rules.name: The Ledger Surface Rule
rules.body: The dashboard is mostly one continuous dark surface. Use dividers and spacing before adding cards.

rules.name: The Mint Rarity Rule
rules.body: Mint is for meaning: value, progress, active state, and urgency. It is not decoration.

rules.name: The Serif Money Rule
rules.body: Important financial values and asset names use the serif voice. Controls and metadata stay sans.

rules.name: The No Floating Cards Rule
rules.body: Dashboard data should not become a stack of rounded cards. Use card containers only when the interaction genuinely needs a framed tool or modal.

dos: Do use assets/screenshots_2/dashboard_idea_1.png as the current visual baseline.
Do make the total portfolio value the dominant first read.
Do use serif type for money and asset names.
Do use thin dividers and spacing before introducing cards.
Do reserve mint for value, progress, status, and active navigation.
donts: Don't make Trafin feel like a generic SaaS dashboard.
Don't use crypto trading interface patterns, noisy chart colors, or speculative-investing visual language.
Don't make the product feel like a loud marketing site.
Don't use promotion-heavy consumer banking patterns.
Don't turn the dashboard into a grid of rounded cards.
Don't add decorative shadows or glass effects to the ledger surface.
